name: jam-mode
description: Run bounded, adaptive Codex campaigns with validated per-role model and reasoning routing across fresh sessions.

interface.longDescription: JAM Mode maintains a durable objective across naturally ending Codex sessions. Each fresh episode reviews prior transcripts, structured state, and relevant memories; selects a task profile and the smallest useful solo or multi-agent strategy; routes named child roles to configurable models and reasoning efforts validated against the installed Codex model catalog; records a task-neutral handoff; and starts another session only when operating boundaries, user state, progress, expected value, and budgets permit it.
capabilities: Adaptive task profiles and named-agent strategies
defaultPrompt: Start an adaptive JAM campaign for this workspace using the balanced model-routing policy.
Configure JAM model routing and show the resolved named-agent roster.
Show the status and model activity of my active JAM campaign.
